::: {.justify}
I am a third-year PhD student in the [Department of Statistical Science](https://statistics.artsandsciences.baylor.edu/) at [Baylor University, Waco, Texas](https://www.baylor.edu/). I graduated with a master's degree in Mathematics-Statistics from [South Dakota State University](https://www.sdstate.edu/programs/graduate/mathematics-ms-statistics-specialization) where I had the opportunity to build a strong foundation in Linear Algebra, Machine Learning(Clustering & Classification Algorithms) and Probability Theory. 

While at SDSU and under the supervision of [Professor Semhar Michael](https://sites.google.com/view/semharmichael/home), I completed a clustering and classification project that won a Poster Presentation award at the [2023 SDSU Data Science Symposium](https://www.facebook.com/share/1DL3zMKgDD/?mibextid=wwXIfr). The same project was selected for presentation at the [2023 International Indian Statistical Association Conference](https://www.intindstat.org/conference2023/program) held on the campus of Colorado School of Mines. With this experience, I believe I am well-prepared to take on new and challenging projects in Statistics and Machine Learning.


At [Baylor](https://www.baylor.edu/), I continue to learn statistical methods for Bayesian Inference, Survival Analysis and Clinical Trial.  Currently, I am working with [Professor James Stamey](https://statistics.artsandsciences.baylor.edu/person/dr-james-d-stamey) and [Dr Jackson Barth](https://statistics.artsandsciences.baylor.edu/person/dr-james-d-stamey) to improve upon the existing Bayesian methods for modeling under-reported and zero-inflated count data.

Outside the classroom, I do spend time talking to my family, taking nature photographs along the Brazos river and playing soccer.

Learn about my professional and academic journey here on this page.
:::
